meta.name: computer-use
meta.description: OS/window-level inspection and input in visible local app windows through `orca computer`: native apps, external browser windows (Chrome, Edge, Safari), and app webviews. Not for Orca's embedded browser (use `orca-cli`) or page-only automation (use Playwright or CDP).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作本地可见应用窗口,完成点击、输入与界面内容读取
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让程序代替你在桌面应用窗口里手动点击和输入。
copy.tagline_en: Automate clicks, typing, and reading content inside visible local app windows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a program to click and type in desktop app windows for you.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 `orca computer` 在可见的本地应用窗口里做窗口级检查和输入,覆盖原生应用、Chrome/Edge/Safari 等外部浏览器窗口和应用内嵌网页。执行前它先确定本次会话该用哪个 CLI 可执行文件,再加载与之版本匹配的引导。
howto.when: 当你让 Claude 在可见的本地应用窗口或 Chrome、Edge 等外部浏览器窗口里做检查与输入时接管。Orca 内嵌浏览器和纯页面自动化不在范围内,原文分别指向 orca-cli 与 Playwright/CDP。

say.text: 用电脑操作的方式看一下我当前的 Chrome 窗口
say.note: 它会先确定本次会话的 orca 可执行文件

say.text: 在这个本地应用窗口里填入并提交表单
say.note: 通过 orca computer 做窗口级输入

say.text: Orca 没在运行的话,先启动它再继续
say.note: 会执行 ORCA open --json 后重试

howto.what_en: Claude uses `orca computer` to inspect and send input at the OS/window level in visible local app windows: native apps, external browser windows, and app webviews. It first resolves the session CLI, then loads the version-matched guide.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to inspect or send input in a visible local app or external browser window. Orca's embedded browser and page-only automation are out of scope.

say_en.text: Use computer use to look at my current Chrome window
say_en.note: It first resolves the orca executable for this session

say_en.text: Fill in and submit the form in this native app window
If Orca isn't running, start it and retry
